title: print: a print action cannot name the PDF from the record — the attachment is always `<page>-<recordId>.pdf`
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

**Found by** hotcrm#2600 (bundle PR hotcrm#2628), measured on 18.5.0; re-read on objectstack main.

Printing a quote attaches `quote_print_page-<record id>.pdf`, which tells the reader nothing about which quote it is.

**Why (code):** `packages/services/service-print/src/print-service.ts:323` — `const filename = req.filename ?? \`${req.page}-${req.recordId}.pdf\``. The service accepts a `filename`, but an app cannot fill it from the record: the action's `bodyExtra` takes static values and `{{page.<var>}}` only (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` ~2161), so no record field (e.g. the quote number) can reach it.

**Expected:** a way to name the file from the record, e.g. `filename` as a template over record fields, or a default built from the record's title (ADR-0079 display field) instead of its id.
